# Generated by tools/generate_pp_goods_output_map_modes.py - do not edit by hand.
# Fixed bucket heatmap: raw = local output x market_access; colors lerp inside each configured range.
# Locations with zero local output of the good get no overlay (terrain); sea/unowned stay grey.

@zoom_step_near = 2
@data_gradient_alpha_inside = 1
@data_gradient_alpha_outside = 1
@data_gradient_width = 0.25
@data_gradient_color_mult = 0.9
@data_edge_width = 0
@data_edge_sharpness = 0.01
@data_edge_alpha = 0
@data_edge_color_mult = 0
@data_before_lighting_blend = 0.5
@data_after_lighting_blend = 0.5

pp_alum_output = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:alum)" > 0
				pp_alum_output_raw < 10
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MIN
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
				factor = {
					value = pp_alum_output_raw
					divide = 10
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:alum)" > 0
				pp_alum_output_raw < 30
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
				factor = {
					value = pp_alum_output_raw
					subtract = 10
					divide = 20
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:alum)" > 0
				pp_alum_output_raw < 60
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
				factor = {
					value = pp_alum_output_raw
					subtract = 30
					divide = 30
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:alum)" > 0
				pp_alum_output_raw < 100
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX
				factor = {
					value = pp_alum_output_raw
					subtract = 60
					divide = 40
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:alum)" > 0
				pp_alum_output_raw < 150
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
				factor = {
					value = pp_alum_output_raw
					subtract = 100
					divide = 50
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:alum)" > 0
				pp_alum_output_raw < 300
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
				max_color = rgb { 245 245 245 }
				factor = {
					value = pp_alum_output_raw
					subtract = 150
					divide = 150
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:alum)" > 0
			}
			value = rgb { 70 210 255 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_owner = yes }
					is_land = no
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 128 128 128 }
		}
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_RANGE_0_10"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MIN
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_RANGE_10_30"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_RANGE_30_60"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_RANGE_60_100"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_RANGE_100_150"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_RANGE_150_300"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_CAPPED"
		color = rgb { 70 210 255 }
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = { limit = { is_land = yes } value = MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_TT_LAND }
		else = { value = MAPMODE_PP_ALUM_OUTPUT_TT_WATER }
	}
	small_map_names = location
	medium_map_names = location
	large_map_names = location
	small_tooltip_context = location
	medium_tooltip_context = location
	large_tooltip_context = location
	fill_in_impassable = yes
	enable_snow = no
	flatmap_behaviour = always
	use_fow = no
	category = economy
	index = 3
	map_markers = { all = no }
	gradient_parameters = {
		zoom_step = @zoom_step_near
		gradient_alpha_inside = @data_gradient_alpha_inside
		gradient_alpha_outside = @data_gradient_alpha_outside
		gradient_width = @data_gradient_width
		gradient_color_mult = @data_gradient_color_mult
		edge_width = @data_edge_width
		edge_sharpness = @data_edge_sharpness
		edge_alpha = @data_edge_alpha
		edge_color_mult = @data_edge_color_mult
		before_lighting_blend = @data_before_lighting_blend
		after_lighting_blend = @data_after_lighting_blend
	}
	color_refresh_counters = { Month ProductionList LocationConstructionUnitChanged MarketReach }
	color_and_names_refresh_counters = { LocationOwnerChanged CountryStatus MarketReach }
}

pp_books_output = {
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:books)" > 0
				pp_books_output_raw < 10
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MIN
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
				factor = {
					value = pp_books_output_raw
					divide = 10
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:books)" > 0
				pp_books_output_raw < 30
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
				factor = {
					value = pp_books_output_raw
					subtract = 10
					divide = 20
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:books)" > 0
				pp_books_output_raw < 60
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
				factor = {
					value = pp_books_output_raw
					subtract = 30
					divide = 30
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:books)" > 0
				pp_books_output_raw < 100
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX
				factor = {
					value = pp_books_output_raw
					subtract = 60
					divide = 40
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:books)" > 0
				pp_books_output_raw < 150
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
				factor = {
					value = pp_books_output_raw
					subtract = 100
					divide = 50
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:books)" > 0
				pp_books_output_raw < 300
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
				max_color = rgb { 245 245 245 }
				factor = {
					value = pp_books_output_raw
					subtract = 150
					divide = 150
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:books)" > 0
			}
			value = rgb { 70 210 255 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_owner = yes }
					is_land = no
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 128 128 128 }
		}
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_BOOKS_OUTPUT_RANGE_0_10"

	}
	legend_key = {

	legend_key = {

	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_BOOKS_OUTPUT_RANGE_60_100"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_BOOKS_OUTPUT_RANGE_100_150"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_BOOKS_OUTPUT_RANGE_150_300"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_BOOKS_OUTPUT_CAPPED"
		color = rgb { 70 210 255 }
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = { limit = { is_land = yes } value = MAPMODE_PP_BOOKS_OUTPUT_TT_LAND }
		else = { value = MAPMODE_PP_BOOKS_OUTPUT_TT_WATER }

				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:coffee)" > 0
				pp_coffee_output_raw < 10
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MIN
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
				factor = {
					value = pp_coffee_output_raw
					divide = 10
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:coffee)" > 0
				pp_coffee_output_raw < 30
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_LOW
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
				factor = {
					value = pp_coffee_output_raw
					subtract = 10
					divide = 20
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:coffee)" > 0
				pp_coffee_output_raw < 60
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MID
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
				factor = {
					value = pp_coffee_output_raw
					subtract = 30
					divide = 30
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:coffee)" > 0
				pp_coffee_output_raw < 100
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX
				factor = {
					value = pp_coffee_output_raw
					subtract = 60
					divide = 40
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:coffee)" > 0
				pp_coffee_output_raw < 150
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX
				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
				factor = {
					value = pp_coffee_output_raw
					subtract = 100
					divide = 50
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:coffee)" > 0
				pp_coffee_output_raw < 300
			}
			lerp = {
				min_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
				max_color = rgb { 245 245 245 }
				factor = {
					value = pp_coffee_output_raw
					subtract = 150
					divide = 150
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:coffee)" > 0
			}
			value = rgb { 70 210 255 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_owner = yes }
					is_land = no
				}
			}
			value = rgb { 128 128 128 }
		}
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_COFFEE_OUTPUT_RANGE_0_10"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MIN
	}
	legend_key = {

	}
	legend_key = {

	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_COFFEE_OUTPUT_RANGE_60_100"
		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_COFFEE_OUTPUT_RANGE_100_150"

	}
	legend_key = {

		color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_TOP
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "MAPMODE_PP_COFFEE_OUTPUT_CAPPED"
		color = rgb { 70 210 255 }
	}
	tooltip_key = {
		if = { limit = { is_land = yes } value = MAPMODE_PP_COFFEE_OUTPUT_TT_LAND }
		else = { value = MAPMODE_PP_COFFEE_OUTPUT_TT_WATER }

				pp_fish_output_raw < 30

				pp_fish_output_raw < 100
			}
			lerp = {

				max_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_MAX

					value = pp_fish_output_raw
					subtract = 150
					divide = 150
					max = 1
					min = 0
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				"goods_output(goods:fish)" > 0
			}
			value = rgb { 70 210 255 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {

					is_land = no
				}
